Pride in Every Job

Why Choose Probuild

There are a lot of builders that do good work and there are builders that do bad work. We do fantastic work and always take pride in everything we do.

  • Planned Before We Start

    Every job is planned out and agreed with you before work begins, so there are no surprises.

  • Clear Timescales

    You know how long it should take from the start: 1 to 3 weeks for most kitchens and bathrooms, 8 to 14 weeks for an extension.

  • Building Control Led

    Extensions and loft conversions go through building control, with the structural calculations done first.

  • One Team, Every Trade

    A team of 8 covering building, tiling, painting, electrics and plumbing, so one firm runs the whole job.

  • Local to Gloucester

    Based in Gloucester and working across Gloucestershire, from Cheltenham and Stroud to the Cotswolds and the Forest of Dean.

About Us

The Team Behind Probuild

Probuild is run by Michael Tomkins. After a number of years self-employed, Michael partnered up with another builder to form the business, and together they lead a team of 8 tradespeople.

The whole team is local to Gloucestershire and takes pride in the work across all the trades. We work for homeowners, landowners, landlords and property developers, and every job is planned with the customer before it starts.

Michael TomkinsOwner, Probuild Property Maintenance Ltd
